description: An infinite cardinal \(k\) is regular exactly when every subset of \(k.\mathrm{ord}\) of cardinality below \(k\) has a strict upper bound below \(k\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.Cofinality.regular_iff_bounded.{u} (k : Cardinal.{u}) (hk : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ k) :
  k.IsRegular ↔ ∀ (s : Set k.ord.ToType), Cardinal.mk ↑s < k → ∃ b, ∀ x ∈ s, x < b
